project_type: TypeScript/Node.js monorepo (discovery layer) + Python/FastAPI service (orchestration layer)
test_command: pnpm --filter @quiz/project-llm-discovery test (TypeScript), cd services/project-ai && pytest tests/ (Python)
verification_instructions: 1. Generate TypeScript snapshot: pnpm --filter @quiz/project-llm-discovery scan, 2. Run TypeScript tests: pnpm --filter @quiz/project-llm-discovery test, 3. Run Python tests: cd services/project-ai && pytest tests/, 4. Verify evidence directory structure exists: .project-ai/runs/, 5. Verify agent handlers exist: services/project-ai/app/agents/
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/project-llm-discovery/output/snapshot.json (generated by TypeScript discovery scanners, not checked in, required for Python service operation). Generate with: pnpm --filter @quiz/project-llm-discovery scan
environment_constraints: Python 3.11+ required (datetime.UTC support), Windows platform (symlink fallback needed for .project-ai/current), pnpm 9.15.4 package manager, Node 20.x, no Playwright installation in Python (architectural rule: Python orchestrates Node/Playwright via subprocess)
contribution_requirements: 1. TypeScript discovery is authoritative source of repository facts (Python never scans files), 2. All evidence IDs from TypeScript (no synthetic IDs in Python), 3. PlacementManifest required for all certification gates (no path inference), 4. Canonical documentation is append-only (never recreate), 5. All JSON evidence files use 2-space indentation, 6. datetime.now(datetime.UTC) not datetime.utcnow() (Python 3.13 compatibility), 7. Test coverage target: 80%+
key_patterns: 1. EvidenceRecord dataclass pattern for parsing TypeScript snapshot evidence, 2. AgentContext/AgentResult pattern for agent execution, 3. GateExecutionResult pattern for certification gates (CertificationGateStatus: PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED), 4. PlacementManifest hash verification for tamper detection, 5. Run directory naming: .project-ai/runs/{commit-sha}-{snapshot-hash}/, 6. Evidence logger creates gates/, agents/, screenshots/ subdirectories, 7. Agent dispatch mechanism maps AgentType to handler functions in execute_agent()
directory_structure: Root: quiz-platform/ → packages/project-llm-discovery/ (TypeScript discovery scanners D1-D6, validators V1-V9, evidence infrastructure, CLI), services/project-ai/ (Python FastAPI orchestration, app/api/routes, app/certification/gates.py, app/orchestration/, app/models/, app/verification/, tests/), .agents/tasks/ (canonical documentation, design docs, wave reports), .project-ai/ (evidence run directories - TO BE CREATED)
